title: Deep learning predicts the origin of bone metastatic cancer from H&E slides
summary: A regional multiple-instance learning model trained on 1041 cases from eight hospitals (26,431 regions of interest) reached top-1 and top-3 accuracy of 91.35% and 97.75% within cohort and 97.44% top-3 in an external cohort. On 175 unknown-origin cases, top-1 and top-3 consistency with immunohistochemistry was 83.90% and 94.33%. Retrospective; IHC agreement is not histologic ground truth.
ai_technology: Regional multiple-instance deep learning on H&E whole-slide regions

evidence.tested: Ten-fold cross-validation, an external cohort and consistency with IHC on 175 unknown-origin cases.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical benefit; split level and external cohort provenance were not read.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicted the primary site from H&E images alone.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read for this DOI. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
